dependencies.reason: Removes obsolete packages (session, skills, compaction, middleware, stop), removes dead tools, and renames module path.
Rewrites provider/anthropic over official SDK, provides anthropic.Resolve, Claude catalog.Lookup, Effort, strict tool declarations, and cache breakpoints.
Establishes agentkit.Config and minimal driver loop with prefix caching breakpoints, transcript pruning, batch execution, and termination handling.
Defines ReachableTools, NestedCaller, and wrapper resolution semantics preserved in core.
Defines Starlark code mode which validates tool arguments against schema and runs nested calls.

tasks.title: Prune core Message and ContentBlock types and remove jsonx dependencies
steps: In core/message.go, restrict Message implementations to UserMessage, AssistantMessage, and ToolResultMessage, and seal the interface
In core/message.go, restrict ContentBlock implementations to TextBlock, ThinkingBlock, and ToolUseBlock, deleting ImageBlock, RawBlock, and ToolResultBlock declarations
From UserMessage, AssistantMessage, and ToolResultMessage, remove Unknown jsonx.OrderedObject and Deferred *DeferredHandle fields
In ToolUseBlock, keep ID, Name, Input of type json.RawMessage, ThoughtSignature, and delete InputOrder
In AssistantMessage, replace ThinkingLevel with Effort of type Effort, and remove legacy API and Provider provenance fields
Write unit tests TS-12-1 and TS-12-2 verifying sealed interfaces and pruned struct fields
done_when: core.Message and core.ContentBlock are sealed interfaces with specified implementors only
ImageBlock, RawBlock, ToolResultBlock, jsonx references, and ThinkingLevel are removed from core/message.go

tasks.title: Refactor core argument preparation and guarantee byte stability
steps: In core/arguments.go, redefine PreparedArguments with Raw json.RawMessage, Args map[string]any, and Coercions []schema.Coercion, removing jsonx.OrderedObject Order
Update PrepareArguments to parse raw arguments without jsonx, preserving original ToolUseBlock.Input bytes in PreparedArguments.Raw by default
When tool.PrepareArguments mutates the argument map, re-encode to JSON and update PreparedArguments.Raw with mutated bytes
When argument validation fails against tool.InputSchema, return zero PreparedArguments and non-nil validation error
Write unit tests TS-12-3, TS-12-4, TS-12-5, and TS-12-6 verifying field definitions, byte preservation, mutation re-encoding, and schema validation failures
done_when: PreparedArguments contains Raw, Args, and Coercions without jsonx
PrepareArguments preserves verbatim Raw bytes unless mutated by tool hook, and rejects schema violations

tasks.title: Streamline core ProviderClient interface and Request model
steps: In core/provider.go, redefine ProviderClient interface with single method Stream(ctx context.Context, req Request) (<-chan StreamEvent, error)
Define StreamEvent with Event Event and Err error
Define Request with System []ContentBlock, Messages Messages, Tools []ToolWire, ToolChoice ToolChoice, MaxTokens *int, Temperature *float64, TopP *float64, StopSequences []string, and Effort Effort
Delete obsolete provider abstractions: ProviderRegistry, ProviderStreamOptions, ClientFunc, StreamFunc, APIProvider, Complete, and Dispatch
Write unit tests TS-12-7, TS-12-8, and TS-12-9 verifying ProviderClient signature, deleted registry types, and Stream error reporting
done_when: ProviderClient defines single Stream method returning (<-chan StreamEvent, error)
StreamEvent and Request match simplified canonical structs without registry or middleware types

tasks.title: Prune core Tool, ToolWire, Usage, and Model declarations
steps: In core/tool.go, keep core execution fields on Tool, remove MCPServer field, and delete MCPServerOf helper
In core/tool.go, retain Name, Description, and InputSchema on ToolWire while removing ConstrainedSampling
In core/usage.go, retain Usage, RunResult, RunStopReason, and StopReason, while deleting ThinkingLevel enum and comparison predicates
In core/usage.go, retain Model tracking fields and ThinkingKind, deleting Model.API and Model.Provider
Write unit tests TS-12-10 and TS-12-11 verifying cleaned Tool, ToolWire, Usage, and Model declarations
done_when: Tool, ToolWire, Usage, and Model omit legacy MCP, ConstrainedSampling, ThinkingLevel, API, and Provider fields

tasks.title: Delete core history and config files and enforce vocabulary size limits
steps: Delete core/history.go and its session tree types (ConversationHistory, SnapshotBranch, SessionHeader, Entry, EntryID, MessageEntry, CompactionEntry)
Delete core/config.go and its legacy configuration types (AgentConfig, StopContext, StopPolicy, ContextTransform, Hooks, QueueMode)
Audit and clean up core package exported identifiers to ensure <= 50 exported types and <= 1,600 non-test lines
Verify that root module non-test lines remain under 20,000 lines
Write unit tests TS-12-12 and TS-12-14 and property test TS-12-13 verifying deleted files/types, exported type bounds, and line count budgets
done_when: core exported type count is <= 50, core production lines <= 1,600, root module lines <= 20,000

tasks.title: Delete jsonx package and eliminate all jsonx imports
steps: Delete directory jsonx/ and files jsonx/ordered.go and jsonx/ordered_probe_test.go
Remove all jsonx imports across core, schema, tools, mcp, and other root module files
Write unit test TS-12-15 and property tests TS-12-16 and TS-12-17 verifying filesystem deletion and absence of jsonx imports
done_when: jsonx package directory is deleted and no source files import jsonx

tasks.title: Implement order-preserving schema.Parse using jsontext
steps: In schema/schema.go, implement Parse(data []byte) (*Schema, error) using encoding/json/jsontext.NewDecoder
Traverse object tokens with jsontext, recording property keys in slice declaration order in Schema.PropertyOrder
Decode child property schemas into Properties map and populate standard keywords (Required, Type, Description, Title, Items, Enum, Const, Nullable, AnyOf, OneOf, AllOf)
Preserve unmodeled keywords in Schema.Extra while retaining key order
Reject syntactically malformed JSON bytes or unclosed tokens with a descriptive parse error
Write unit tests TS-12-18, TS-12-19, TS-12-20, and TS-12-21 verifying order preservation, keyword decoding, Extra preservation, and parse errors
done_when: schema.Parse decodes JSON Schema bytes using jsontext, preserving PropertyOrder and populating standard keywords and Extra

tasks.title: Complete JSON schema constraint validation and safe coercion
steps: In schema/impl.go, reject unknown object properties when AdditionalProperties.Allowed is false against declared Properties and PropertyOrder
Enforce exact literal value and type equality for declared Enum choices in schema.Validate
Enforce relational bounds for Minimum, Maximum, ExclusiveMinimum, ExclusiveMaximum, and MultipleOf on numeric values
Enforce string constraints for MinLength, MaxLength, and Pattern regex matching
Enforce array constraints for MinItems, MaxItems, and UniqueItems uniqueness checks
In schema.Coerce, parse primitive strings into numeric or boolean representations, recording Coercion records while refusing non-standard literals (NaN, Inf, +5, .5, 5., 1_0)
Write unit tests TS-12-22, TS-12-23, TS-12-24, TS-12-25, TS-12-26, TS-12-27, and TS-12-28 verifying constraint validations and coercion safety
done_when: schema.Validate enforces issue 87 constraints and schema.Coerce safely converts primitives rejecting invalid literals

tasks.title: Reshape shell guard as a pure authorization function and update Restricted adapter
steps: In guard/guard.go, define Decision struct with Block bool, Reason string, and Terminate bool
Update ShellToolNames to []string{\"execute\", \"run_command\"}
Implement pure function Check(argv []string, opts Options) Decision: block empty argv, match separator paths against cleaned allowlist entries, and match bare names against bare allowlist entries
Refactor Restricted(opts Options) core.BeforeToolCall to evaluate blocked tools, shell operators, and environment prefix assignments, delegating program evaluation to Check
Write unit tests TS-12-29, TS-12-30, TS-12-31, TS-12-32, TS-12-33, and TS-12-34 verifying Decision, Check authorization rules, and Restricted hook behavior
done_when: guard.Check evaluates argv against allowlists as a pure function returning Decision
guard.ShellToolNames is [execute, run_command] and Restricted delegates program evaluation to Check

tasks.title: Simplify system prompt assembly and guideline deduplication
steps: In prompt/prompt.go, change Build signature to func Build(system string, tools []core.Tool) string
When system is empty, start with BaseInstructions and UniversalGuidelines; when non-empty, use system in place of both
Append PromptGuidelines from tools in first-seen order, deduplicating identical guidelines
Inject ExecuteFallbackGuideline when execute is present without search tools, or SearchOverExecuteGuideline when both execute and search tools are present
Delete prompt.Input, prompt.SkillBlocks, and all imports of skills package
Write unit tests TS-12-35, TS-12-36, and TS-12-37 verifying Build signature, instruction selection, guideline deduplication, and shell fallback rules
done_when: prompt.Build signature is func Build(system string, tools []core.Tool) string
Base instructions/custom prompt override, tool guideline deduplication, and shell guideline injection work as specified
prompt.Input, prompt.SkillBlocks, and skills package imports are removed
